clues.text: When she slaughtered the prophets of the LORD, Obadiah hid a hundred of them, fifty men per cave.
Elijah called four hundred prophets of Asherah to Mount Carmel, prophets who ate at her table.
Told by Ahab that Elijah had killed all the prophets with the sword, she vowed to take his life by the next day.
She wrote letters in Ahab's name, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the elders of Naboth's city.
Elijah spoke the LORD's word that dogs would devour this wife of King Ahab by the city wall.
When Jehu arrived in her city, this queen painted her eyes, adorned her head, and looked down from a window.
In the letter to the church in Thyatira, Jesus warns about a woman by this name who calls herself a prophetess.
